content.text: {"story":{"as_a":"user of the task manager","i_want":"to update an existing task","so_that":"I can correct its title, description, priority or Due Date","business_description":"Lets users change the details of an existing task after it is created, using the same validation as task creation.","business_value":"Tasks stay accurate without being deleted and recreated.","acceptance_criteria":[{"given":"an existing task with a valid title and a Due Date not earlier than its Creation Date","when":"the user opens the edit form, changes the title, and submits the form","then":"the backend stores the new title and the task shows the new title in the list after the backend returns success"},{"given":"an existing task being edited in the form","when":"the user clears the title field and submits the form","then":"the backend rejects the update, the task keeps its previous title, and an error message stating that the title is mandatory is shown"},{"given":"an existing task with Creation Date 2024-05-10","when":"the user sets the Due Date to 2024-05-09 and submits the update","then":"the backend rejects the update with a validation error, the stored Due Date is unchanged, and an error message is shown"},{"given":"an existing task with a title of 100 characters","when":"the user changes the title to 101 characters and submits the update","then":"the backend rejects the update with a validation error, the stored title is unchanged, and an error message stating that the title must be 100 characters or fewer is shown"},{"given":"an existing task being edited in the form","when":"the user changes the description or priority and submits the form with valid values","then":"the backend stores the new description or priority and the task shows the new values in the list after the backend returns success"},{"given":"an existing task whose update request succeeds","when":"the backend saves the update","then":"the backend sets the task's Last Updated Date to the time of the update"},{"given":"a task update request where the backend returns an error","when":"the frontend receives the error response","then":"the frontend does not show the task as updated and displays an error message"},{"given":"a task update request where the backend returns success","when":"the frontend receives the success response","then":"the frontend displays a success message after the update action"},{"given":"a task ID that does not exist in the database","when":"an update request is sent for that ID","then":"the backend returns a Task Not Found error, no data is changed, and the frontend shows a Task Not Found error message"},{"given":"the database is unavailable during an update","when":"the update is submitted","then":"the backend returns an internal/database error, the stored task is unchanged, and the frontend shows an error message and does not show the task as updated"}],"edge_cases":[],"dependencies":[],"definition_of_done":["Update covers Title, Description, Priority and Due Date with the same validation as create","Frontend shows success or error message after every update and never shows an optimistic update"]},"fixes":[{"finding":1,"revised_tasks":[{"task_key":"BE-task-update-endpoint","task":{"key_slug":"task-update-endpoint","title":"[BE] Add task update endpoint by ID with validation and Last Updated Date","track":"backend","area":"backend","description":"Add an update endpoint for an existing task by ID. Validate title (mandatory, max 100 characters), Due Date (not earlier than Creation Date), Description and Priority with the same rules as create. Return Task Not Found for unknown IDs, a missing mandatory field error when the title is empty, an invalid input error for failed validation, and an internal/database error when the database is unavailable. Store nothing on any error.
